name: Frutiger Aero
description: Frutiger Aero features glossy, translucent surfaces, shiny 3D icons, smooth gradients, and soft lighting. Its visuals often combine bright blues, greens, and whites with bubbles, water droplets, clear skies, landscapes, and glowing light effects.

name: Vector Funk/ Frutiger Metro
description: Vectordelia (Frutiger Metro) features vibrant vector graphics, flowing curves, abstract shapes, bold silhouettes, and layered patterns. Its visuals often combine bright, saturated colors with gradients, stars, splatters, and music-inspired imagery for an energetic, groovy look.

name: Vector Grunge
description: Vector Grunge features dark backgrounds, colorful splatters, overlapping patterns, and edgy vector shapes. Its visuals combine bold colors with chaotic designs inspired by emo and scene culture.

name: Shoe Diva
description: Shoe Diva features colorful, sketch-like illustrations of high heels, fashionable women, shopping bags, and girly accessories, decorated with sparkles, hearts, and playful looping lines.

name: Metalheart
description: Metalheart features distorted 3D forms, metallic textures, geometric patterns, and futuristic digital interfaces. Futuristic visuals, thin glowing lines, grids, and technological typography that stand out against dark, blurred backgrounds.

name: Glitter Graphics
description: Sparkling web graphics featuring glitter effects, decorative text, hearts, stars, flowers, and layered images made for personal profiles and early webpages.
